programme.title: For Whom The Bell Tolls
programme.desc: (1943) Drama. Director Sam Wood's epic adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's classic story about the Spanish Civil War. Starring Oscar-nominees Gary Cooper and Ingrid Bergman.

programme.title: Cleopatra
programme.desc: (1963) Drama. Elizabeth Taylor plays the Egyptian queen who, to protect her realm, uses political guile and her body to woo Julius Caesar (Rex Harrison) and Mark Antony (Richard Burton).

programme.title: Charlotte Gray
programme.desc: (2001) World War II thriller. Cate Blanchett stars as a secret agent sent to occupied France to aid the Resistance against the Nazis. But she has her own agenda. With Michael Gambon.

programme.title: Copshop
programme.desc: (2021) Action thriller with Gerard Butler. A hitman gets himself arrested so that he can get to a bad guy, who also got himself arrested, so that he could hide from the hitman.

programme.title: The Son
programme.desc: (2022) Hugh Jackman, Vanessa Kirby, Laura Dern, Zen McGrath and Anthony Hopkins star in Florian Zeller's domestic drama about a father struggling to deal with his teenage son's depression.

programme.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programme.desc: (2019) Visually stunning part-animated action film based on a popular manga. A deadly cyborg who's been brought back to life by a mourning scientist sets out to discover her true identity.

programme.title: Criss Cross
programme.desc: (1949) Muscular film noir starring Burt Lancaster and Yvonne De Carlo. A dame convinces her ex-husband, an armoured car guard, to come in on a daring robbery.

programme.title: The Lady Eve
programme.desc: (1941) Screwball romcom with Barbara Stanwyck and Henry Fonda. A con artist is forced to change tack when she falls for her mark and he dumps her for trying to con him in the first place.

programme.title: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: (1954) Classic 'cowboys and Indians' Western. Gary Cooper, Richard Widmark and Cameron Mitchell star as three rascals hired by Susan Hayward to rescue her husband from Apache territory.

programme.title: Hell and High Water
programme.desc: (1954) Cold War thriller. Richard Widmark stars as the leader of a submarine expedition, sent to the frozen depths of Alaska to thwart the Chinese communists' plans to start WWIII.

programme.title: Uncharted
programme.desc: (2022) Going-for-gold action. Tom Holland and Mark Wahlberg compare abs as they scour the globe for an olde explorer's lost gold. The heat is on. The time is right. Only the best survive.

programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: (1996) Comedy starring Michael Keaton and Andie MacDowell. Buckling under stresses at work and home, a man decides to clone himself. But he doesn't tell his wife, causing much confusion.

programme.title: The 355
programme.desc: (2022) Action spy caper with Jessica Chastain, Diane Kruger and Penélope Cruz. A global alliance of elite operatives team up to kick ass and retrieve some stolen world-ending tech.

programme.title: Lean on Pete
programme.desc: (2017) Andrew Haigh's heartstring-tugging equine road movie follows a lad from a poor background and broken home who goes on the run with an ageing racehorse.

programme.desc: Big Budget Brides. Bride Monisha has come to Kleinfelds looking for a dress for her three wedding ceremonies, and Mary has a budget of thirty thousand dollars to buy two dresses. S8, Ep10

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Expecting Brides. Tisa's looking for a dress that makes her look hot even though she's 3 months pregnant, and Emily is 6 months pregnant and at trying on her gown for the first time. S8, Ep11

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Worth the Weight. Kristy has lost 100 pounds and is looking for the right dress to show off her new figure, and Kristin has lost 40 pounds and is excited to fit into dress samples. S8, Ep12

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Rocker Brides. Kristin wants to find a rock and roll, edgy wedding dress, meanwhile Amber has two wedding dress priorities - a dress that is different and shows off her tattoos. S8, Ep13

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress Lancashire
programme.desc: See Through Showdown. Bride Mel is hoping to find a wedding dress that will show off her body. Meanwhile, can Gok keep the peace between Hayley and her opinionated mum? S2, Ep11

programme.title: The Killer In My Family

programme.title: On the Case with Paula Zahn
programme.desc: Unthinkable Betrayal. Police must solve the murder of a young mother who was savagely strangled to death in her bed while her two young sons slept just steps away. S12, Ep25

programme.title: Murder On CCTV
programme.desc: Captain Freddy. When the body of Fernando Silva is found, the crime scene reveals little about what caused his death. Will the cameras help police find out what really happened? S4, Ep15

programme.title: The Killer In My Family
programme.desc: Darren Sykes. A house fire claims the lives of two young boys and their father, Darren Sykes. On further investigation, police uncover a horrific act of revenge. S5, Ep1

programme.title: American Monster

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: By Design. Talented artist Kira and marketing manager Matthew appear to be happily married. Until one day, a maintenance worker makes a grisly discovery. S7, Ep5

programme.title: The Murder Tapes

programme.title: Judge Rinder's Crime Stories
programme.desc: Gladys Godfrey/Ian McNicholl. How did forensic technology help track down the killer of Gladys Godfrey? Plus, Ian McNicholl tells the horrific story of his abusive ex-girlfriend. S5, Ep2

programme.title: Murder On CCTV
programme.desc: Last Look Of Summer. A young woman is found dead in a Texas landfill. Detectives turn to their only witnesses: video cameras that captured the murderer's attempt to cover his tracks. S3, Ep2
